steps.title: Prepare Transfection Solution
steps.instruction: Create a transfection mixture using DNA, PEI, and media.

substeps.instruction: Combine 500ng transfection DNA and 2.5ul PEI in Serum Free Media (OptiMEM) up to a total volume of 50ul.

steps.title: Mix and Incubate Solution
steps.instruction: Homogenize the solution and allow it to react.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the solution twice for 5 seconds each.
Incubate the solution in the hood for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Apply Solution to Cells
steps.instruction: Add the transfection mixture to the culture wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 50ul of the solution per well (500ul total).
